description: This image is not a scientific figure. It is the standard Creative Commons "CC BY" licence badge: a rectangular graphic made of a grey upper band and a black lower band. Within the grey band sit two black-outlined circular icons — on the left a circle containing the letters "CC", and on the right a circle containing a stylised standing human figure (the attribution / "BY" icon). The black lower band carries the white capital letters "BY", centred beneath the two icons. There are no axes, no axis labels or units, no scale bar, no legend, no colour scale, no data points, no table cells and no anatomical or microstructural features of any kind. No sample name, composition, processing condition or measured quantity appears anywhere in the frame. The image therefore yields nothing about the duplex low-density steels Fe-15Mn-10Al-0.8C-5Ni and Fe-15Mn-10Al-0.8C discussed in the paper title and abstract. It is a publisher licence stamp, almost certainly embedded during PDF page production, and should not be treated as a research figure.
